unit: Repository-path HTTP responses, all methods and user agents; known maintenance probes excluded.
grouping: Four named repositories; LeVCS/levcs aliases combined. Other includes smaller repositories, unresolved paths, feed routes retained under .rss names, and the small unallocated residual in retained daily summaries.
coverage: A represented 24-hour UTC date is not certified continuous service uptime. Counts reflect retained records; no extrapolation.

historical_discrepancy.handling: Use the internally consistent hourly cube for Oct 1–13 shares and totals. No synthetic extra response is assigned to a repository. The one-response difference does not change displayed rounded shares.

notes: HTTP 200 includes legitimate visitors and is not proof of a bot.
HTTP 403 combines challenges and denials; the attempts variant includes all statuses.
Shares are descriptive; deployment days mix configurations.
